name: Hara (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Hara village emblem in yellow: a crescent open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain peak.
history: Municipal flag of Hara, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 December 1974; the emblem dates from 13 December 1961.

features.role: Hara village emblem — a crescent open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain peak
